news.title: Rational Launches AI Employees for Accounting Firms

launches.title: Rational - First Zero-human Accounting Firm
launches.body:
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IX4-sMxdslk>

**We’re disrupting the disruptors.**

You’ve heard of so many AI accounting startups already. These new “AI-native” accounting firms are still designed to be run by humans in two facets: the first 25%, fostering client relationships, and the final 25%, signing off and filing with the IRS.

**Josh Kushner’s company, Thrive Holdings, the largest disruptor in this space, explicitly argues that agents will never replace this** \[1\]**.** Their reasoning? Agents don’t carry trust.

Currently, agents are not trusted, humans are. That’s why every AI startup nowadays does the work, and leaves judgment to a human. But this is changing, and we’re early. As new agent-centric companies grow (Instinct, Natural, AgentMail), agents become common in daily life and work, and eventually will become trusted entities \[2\].

Once agents are trusted, there is no reason they cannot own entire, traditionally trust-heavy industries, end-to-end. Rational is building for that world.

**Reach out to [founders@rational.to](mailto:founders@rational.to) or visit [rational.to](http://rational.to) if interested in learning more.**

---

\[1\] <https://www.thriveholdings.com/long-humans>. A fraction of the market does care about trust and the human relationship with their accountant, but most of us definitely do not want to spend a second more with one than we have to.

\[2\] These companies inherently bet on agents to proliferate in society. We also believe AI will continue to get better and safer. Since trust is achieved through consistent, positive actions, and it is in the interest of the entire tech industry for their agents to produce consistent positive actions, our firm will be the first to enjoy the principles to do concrete work in a massive market.

launches.title: Rational: AI Employees for Accounting
launches.tagline: 24/7 hires to solve the talent shortage within your firm's existing stack
launches.body:
Rational builds AI employees for accounting and tax firms. They onboard themselves to your firm, handle real work within your existing tools, and keep a human in control of every decision that matters — so firms can finally say yes to the clients they've been turning away.

<https://youtu.be/mcF30tmNLTg>

_The problem_

Accounting has an economics problem: demand is there, capacity isn't. Most firms turned away paying clients last year simply because they didn't have the people to do the work, and the talent pool keeps shrinking as accountants leave the profession faster than firms can replace them. More software hasn't fixed this — and a chatbot that summarizes a spreadsheet definitely hasn't. The parts of accounting that actually matter, like judgment, trust, and sign-off, should stay human. Everything around them shouldn't have to be a bottleneck.

_Our solution_

Rational’s AI employees conduct interviews with each role on your team, creating a mental map of your firm’s workflows, inefficiencies, and who to route approvals to. After you connect them to your current stack, they simply do the work, 24/7. They learn from every single interaction and become more accurate over time — and their insights are completely isolated for your firm. They’re truly _your_ AI employees.

Rational already works with every firm size: from individuals to Fortune Global 500 companies. Doing everything from document-chasing to research to tax preparation, our employees supplement your firm’s labor without the significant onboarding curve or cost of a new hire.

_Book a Demo_

Stop saying no to clients or retaining inefficiencies in your firm. Hire your first AI employees today, at <https://rational.to/book-demo>.

Not an accounting firm but know someone in PE, advising, or accounting? We would love an introduction. Email founders@rational.to.
